fastMode.description: Native fast-mode outcome reported by the runtime (requested on may still be off).

isDefault.description: The runtime's default model (resolved from a native default alias).

group.description: primary: newest model per family; more: older or extra models.

effortLevels.description: Reasoning effort levels this model accepts; empty when it takes no effort setting. Absent when unknown.

defaultEffort.description: Effort the model uses when the session sets none.

supportsFast.description: The model accepts the fast (priority) service tier.

checkpoint.description: Materialized HxProjection checkpoint for one hostSeq prefix; null when nothing can be projected (no durable events, or a fork session). The authoritative TS type lives in @cowork/hx-projection; its tuple-bearing internals are intentionally opaque at the contract layer.
